purpose: AC-FDC-6 differential corpus. Each case is run through BOTH the Node classifier and the Python floor checker against the shipped permission-floor map; the two must name the identical set of rules for every drift class. Rendered prose differs by design and is not compared.

cases.name: empty-target
cases.why: no configuration at all — every absence class must fire, including the 16 ask entries the vocabulary could not name before AC-FDC-1

cases.name: full-floor-verbatim
cases.why: every map rule present in its declared tier, literal text — no finding of any class

cases.name: full-floor-home-expanded
cases.why: THE CANONICALIZATION CASE. Allow rules as absolute, version-resolved paths — what the harness writes on ask-to-allow persist. Python folded these and Node did not, so the two disagreed on 42 rules; this case is what pins them together

cases.name: cross-tier-placement
cases.why: an allow entry the operator deliberately moved into ask — tier-conflict fires and the false allow-absent is suppressed

cases.name: blanket-star
cases.why: Bash(*) — covers() is false for a body not ending ':*', so every entry still classifies absent and every finding must be qualified

cases.name: blanket-interpreter-word
cases.why: Bash(python3 *) — blanket via the interpreter-word fold, which the old hardcoded three-spelling set reached only by coincidence

cases.name: local-only-origin
cases.why: a rule carried ONLY in the untracked settings.local.json — the union sees it covered; AC-FDC-3's origin is what lets a consumer tell the tracked file apart

cases.name: unclassified-shape
cases.why: a non-Bash rule — reported by tool prefix only, never by body

cases.name: broader-deny-does-not-cover
cases.why: the deny direction refuses the fold and requires EXACT reach equality — a broader deny must NOT stand in for the map's narrower one

cases.name: ask-shadowed-by-broad-allow
cases.why: a broad but NON-blanket allow shadows the ask tier. Two distinct classes must fire: the 15 ceremony entries (scripts/ basenames) give ask-shadowed-ceremony, and the one non-ceremony entry, Bash(claude plugin tag:*), gives plain ask-shadowed — reachable only when that entry is ABSENT from the ask tier and covered from allow, which no blanket case can produce

cases.name: unreadable-and-unclassified
cases.why: a non-Bash rule in each tier — reported by tool prefix only, body never disclosed; these classes name no MAP rule, so the differential compares them as empty on both sides
